name: What are the common limitations of relying solely on AI for real estate decisions?

mainEntity.name: What are the common limitations of relying solely on AI for real estate decisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relying solely on AI for real estate decisions has several limitations. AI cannot replicate the negotiation skills or emotional intelligence of a human agent during complex transactions. It also lacks the ability to conduct physical property inspections or truly understand local community nuances and unlisted factors that affect a home's value or suitability. While AI provides data-driven insights, it doesn't account for seller motivations, subtle neighborhood changes, or unexpected market shifts that a local expert from areas like Miami-Dade County would instinctively recognize. These human elements are crucial for successful property acquisition.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI limitations include lack of negotiation skills, physical inspection capabilities, and understanding of local nuances, which are critical for real estate decisions.
